charts.title: TOI-5817 b: orbits around TOI-5817
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5817's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5817 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Naponiello et al. 2025 (2025A&A...701A..79N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname NAPONIELLO_ET_AL_2025): P 15.61031 d

charts.title: TOI-5817 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5817 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (55, 82) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 418604868, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 12 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 18 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 24-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 12 min early; 24-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 6 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
